name: What are the key stages involved in a kitchen remodel with Opus Builders?

mainEntity.name: What are the key stages involved in a kitchen remodel with Opus Builders?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our kitchen remodeling process begins with an in-depth consultation to understand your vision, needs, and lifestyle. This is followed by detailed design and planning, where our team develops custom layouts, material selections, and 3D renderings. Once the design is approved and permits are secured, we proceed with demolition and structural work. The construction phase involves installing plumbing, electrical, cabinetry, countertops, and appliances. The project concludes with final touches, inspections, and a thorough walkthrough.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process includes consultation, design, permitting, demolition, construction (plumbing, electrical, cabinetry, appliances), and final finishing with inspections.
